name: ink cloud
desc:
A 20-foot-radius cloud of ink extends all around the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} if it is underwater. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink. After releasing the ink, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use the Dash action as a bonus action. Recharges after a Short or Long Rest.
